title: Bronze Saver Account specifications and requirements
summary: This document lists Bronze Saver Account specifications and requirements: minimum opening deposit is $0, interest compounds daily, and a linked Rho-Bank business checking account is required (for setups that specify Yes). It also advises ensuring the checking account stays active, confirming daily compounding in account details, and verifying initial funding meets/exceeds $0.
